Maybe...? For most people the in-depth explanation may be a bit overboard, but I can't say that with absolute confidence. I mean, I do like it, But it feels like it's talking more about `fixed_fps` than `preprocess`.
```suggestion
			[b]Warning:[/b] Setting this property to a very high value can significantly reduce performance and, in extreme cases, lead to a GPU crash. If absolutely necessary, this can be mitigated by lowering the [member fixed_fps], so long as [member fixed_fps] is not [code]0[/code].
```
Or similar.

I also believe this should be a warning as we're talking about a potential crash, or performance so poor it basically becomes impossible to use the editor (as I can gather from the original issue)
